name: Voting
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly governs the appointment of leaders, as seen in how He directs the hearts of kings and rulers (Proverbs 21:1). The establishment of authority, including the choice of leaders, is part of God's design for order among His people, with wise and understanding men chosen to govern (Deuteronomy 1:13). While nations may desire a king or ruler (Deuteronomy 17:14), it is ultimately the Lord who is the true governor over all nations (Psalms 22:28). The character of those in authority profoundly affects the well-being of the people, with righteousness bringing joy and sin bringing reproach and mourning (Proverbs 14:34; 29:2).
